cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND (f.path ENDS WITH 'pom.xml' OR f.path ENDS WITH 'pyproject.toml' OR f.path ENDS WITH 'package.json' OR f.path ENDS WITH '.csproj' OR f.path ENDS WITH 'requirements.txt') AND f.path STARTS WITH $prefix RETURN f.path AS entity,f.path AS fact,[r.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity LIMIT 10
